title: Application repository identity
responsibility: Identifies a checkout by its normalized network origin or canonical local Git store, follows bounded local-clone origins, and compares repository or plain-site membership.

inputs.name: repositoryIdentity.directory
inputs.description: The checkout directory whose application identity is computed; Git reads it with `git -C`, so a relative path is taken from the process working directory. A path that is not a Git repository, a checkout with several remotes and no origin, or a checkout whose remote URL is unrecognized, yields null.

inputs.name: sameRepository.left
inputs.description: The first checkout directory to compare, identified before the right one; when its repository identity is null the result is false and the right directory is never identified.

inputs.name: sameRepository.right
inputs.description: The second checkout directory to compare, identified only when the left identity is non-null; the result is true only when its identity equals the left identity, so a null identity never matches.

inputs.name: sameSite.site
inputs.description: The site directory that defines membership: when its repository identity is non-null, every checkout with that identity belongs to it, while a site in no Git repository admits only its own realpath. A site that does not exist, or one inside a Git repository whose repository identity is null, admits nothing.

inputs.name: sameSite.directory
inputs.description: The candidate directory tested for membership, compared by repository identity when the site has one, or by exact realpath when the site is in no Git repository. A subdirectory of a site in no Git repository is never a member, and so is a path that does not exist.

outputs.name: repositoryIdentity
outputs.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of `remote:host/path` for a network origin (host lowercased, trailing slashes and `.git` removed from the path), or of `local:` plus the realpath of the Git common store for a checkout with no remote, after following at most five local-origin hops. It is null when the directory, or a local origin it follows, is not a repository, when several remotes include no origin, when the remote is neither a local path nor a network address, when the chain is deeper than five hops, or when a Git call times out after 3000 ms; timeouts are never cached, and other results, null included, are cached per directory string in a 256-entry LRU.

outputs.name: sameRepository
outputs.description: True only when both directories resolve to the same non-null repository identity, so a null identity on either side makes the result false.

outputs.name: sameSite
outputs.description: True for a checkout whose non-null repository identity equals that of a repository site, or for a directory whose realpath is exactly that of a site in no Git repository. A site that has a null repository identity while sitting inside a Git repository matches nothing, so the result is false.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A TypeError from fileURLToPath when a file:// remote is not a valid URL, has a host (for example file://server/repo), or holds an encoded slash (%2F) in its path. Only Git timeouts are caught, so repositoryIdentity, sameRepository and sameSite throw it.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: A URIError from decodeURIComponent inside fileURLToPath when the path of a file:// remote holds malformed percent-encoding, such as %zz. Only Git timeouts are caught, so repositoryIdentity, sameRepository and sameSite throw it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A file-system Error (for example code ENOENT or EACCES) from realpathSync on the Git common store, reached only when the checkout has no remote. Only Git timeouts are caught, so repositoryIdentity, sameRepository and sameSite throw it.
